Thanks for the update, Megan — totally understand.

Options that might keep momentum without pulling on your engineers right now:

- Park the pilot and I’ll set a reminder to reach back in early Sept (we can put a 90-day outreach cadence on the record).
- If useful, we can provide a small sandbox and 1k token trial credit so your platform team can poke at integrations asynchronously (no on-site engineer required).
- Or we can do a short 20-min async recording of the core flow I can share with your team.

I’ve looped Marissa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Solutions) so they’re aware. I’ll also add a link to the demo deck and our short checklist to the HubSpot deal record.

If you want us to pause entirely, say the word and we’ll park the deal with an owner note. Otherwise, which of the three options above would you prefer?

Thanks — we’ll stay flexible.

Best,
Priya
